eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CHILD ABDUCTION EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: Adams; Berks; Bradford; Bucks; Carbon; Chester; Columbia; Cumberland; Dauphin; Delaware; Franklin; Lackawanna; Lancaster; Lawrence; Lebanon; Lehigh; Luzerne; Lycoming; Monroe; Montgomery; Montour; Northumberland; Perry; Philadelphia; Pike; Schuylkill; Snyder; Sullivan; Susquehanna; Tioga; Union; Wayne; Wyoming; York, PA; at 11:43 AM on AUG 31, 2022 Effective until 2:43 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
The Pennsylvania State Police has issued an Amber Child Abduction Alert for Reading City Police Department, Berks County. 
Reading City PD is searching for Janae Kalia-Henry, 13 years of age black female, being 5 feet 1 inches approximatley 106 lbs. .  She was last seen in the area of Schuylkill Avenue in Reading City, Berks County on august 31, 2022 at approximately 0200 hours .
She was abducted by an uknown male who placed her into a silver chevrolet traverse with an unkown pa registration.
